card.name: The word to after "up" in limits
card.fires_on: The word "to" right after "up" in phrases like "up to 4 hours" or "up to 45 minutes", where it sets a maximum time or amount. It also fires weakly on "to" in numeric ranges and on "can" or "also" in similar instructions.
